notes.title: Improvements from your feedback
notes.content:
We listened to your feedback and changed a few things in the game to improve it.

[list]
[*] The mechanics are simpler and more intuitive, you just have to exchange the atoms with each other to be able to assemble the entire molecule
[*] Commands are now just by clicking on the mouse, no need to click and hold
[*] Anti atom has been added, it is now that it will need to be thrown in the trash
[*] Only the molecules O, N and Cl will need to be picked up on the board
[*] Some atoms of C and H may be outside the molecule, just place inside after excluding the anti atoms if they exist
[/list]

Minor changes in the order of levels have also been made
